content.title: World Baseball Classic Championship '26: How To Watch Live Online Free
content.text: Home Shopping News World Baseball Classic Championship 2026: Where to Watch Venezuela vs. United States Live Online for Free Daniel Shirey/WBCI/MLB Photos via Getty Images If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Variety may receive an affiliate commission. Ahead of MLB Opening Day on Wednesday, Mar. 25, the best and brightest baseball players from all around the world, such as Aaron Judge, Bryce Harper and others from the United States and Ronald Acuña Jr., Andrés Giménez and others from Venezuela, play in the championship game to find out which country is the best at baseball. On Tuesday, Mar. 17, the 2026 World Baseball Classic Championship: Venezuela vs. United States takes place at loanDepot Park in Miami, Florida, with a start time of 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT. The final game broadcasts on FOX. Related Stories Where to Watch the World Baseball Classic Championship 2026 Live Online Want to watch online? Championship game airs on FOX, with Spanish-language broadcasts and coverage on FOX Deportes. You don’t have to miss any of the action, even without cable. You can access select games on FOX on your TV with one of these affordable indoor digital HD TV antennas. The World Baseball Classic livestreams online on a wide range of streaming platforms, such as DirecTV, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV and others. In fact, some services offer free trials that you can use to livestream the championship game online for free. How to Watch World Baseball Classic Online: Livestream Baseball Tournament Without Cable Want to watch online? Check out the best ways to stream the World Baseball Classic game, below: DirecTV DirecTV DirecTV is one of the best ways for cable-cutters to access live sports and TV from home. Priced at $44.99/month for the first two months of service ($69.99/month afterwards), you get access to the streaming service’s “MySports” package for World Baseball Classic on FOX, along with over 20 sports channels. For coverage in Spanish on FOX Deportes, sign up for DirecTV’s “MiEspañol” package, which comes with more than 60 Spanish-language channels and goes for $34.99/month. Both package also come with a 5-day free trial to watch the international baseball tournament for free. Sling TV Sling TV Sling is one of the best options for affordable live streaming The Sling Select package, which includes FOX, goes for $19.99/month. Please note: Pricing and channel availability are subject to your local TV market. Fubo Fubo The streamer offers a 5-day free trial to try out the service before you commit. Fubo is one of the best options for streaming the baseball tournament. The service features the World Baseball Classic game on FOX, while it has additional channels for Spanish-language coverage on FOX Deportes. The streamer even has more than 200 live TV channels for cable-free streaming with prices starting at $48.99 for the first month ($73.99/month afterwards). Hulu Hulu + Live TV Prices start at $89.99/month. For another great option for to watch Team USA in action, check out Hulu + Live TV for live channel streaming the World Baseball Classic Championship with access to FOX. Starting at $89.99/month, the streaming service has more than 95 other channels, as well as access to hit originals on Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Unlimited.
